title: Towards Group Fairness with Multiple Sensitive Attributes in Federated Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using group fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, Accuracy Parity) and causal effect estimation (Total Effect) on face image classification tasks across federated clients using the CelebA and FairFace datasets.
